messages:
Jess — Support: FYI ticket from customer: they attempted to apply voucher `WELCOME-2026-25` via the API and get `coupon_invalid` / 'expired or invalid'. Dashboard shows the code as active. Screenshot link included: https://files.redwood/test/welcome-2026-25.png

Kai (Eng): Can you paste the raw API request/response here and the exact timestamp from the customer?

Jess — Support: Customer says it happened at 2026-03-15T18:12:04Z. Their curl:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/apply-voucher 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"voucher":"WELCOME-2026-25","account_email":"acct+anna@example.com"}'```
Response body:```{
  "error": {
    "code": "coupon_invalid",
    "message": "Voucher is expired or invalid",
    "http_status": 410
  }
}```

coupon-bot: [coupon-cache] lookup=WELCOME-2026-25 -> state=active end_date=2026-03-30T23:59:59Z max_redemptions=100 redeemed=100 cache_ttl=300s

Ada · Billing: Hmm the bot shows redeemed=100 which equals max_redemptions. That would cause an API reject with 410 even if dashboard UI still shows it as available due to stale view. I just queried the billing DB:```SELECT id, code, redeemed_count, max_redemptions, ends_at FROM vouchers WHERE code='WELCOME-2026-25';```Result:```id: 8272 | code: WELCOME-2026-25 | redeemed_count: 100 | max_redemptions: 100 | ends_at: 2026-03-30 23:59:59+00```

Kai (Eng): That matches. We should check two things: 1) Why dashboard didn't reflect redeemed_count=100 (cache or frontend bug), 2) whether the customer saw a race where two requests hit at the same time and one walked away with the last slot. Can we get the redemption log around 2026-03-15T18:11..18:13Z?

Jess — Support: Attaching the redemption logs from the API gateway (sanitized):```[2026-03-15T18:11:59Z] POST /v1/billing/apply-voucher account=acct+bob@example.com voucher=WELCOME-2026-25 -> 200 redeemed
[2026-03-15T18:12:02Z] POST /v1/billing/apply-voucher account=acct+carol@example.com voucher=WELCOME-2026-25 -> 200 redeemed
[2026-03-15T18:12:04Z] POST /v1/billing/apply-voucher account=acct+anna@example.com voucher=WELCOME-2026-25 -> 410 coupon_invalid```

Ada · Billing: Looks like Anna was third in that short window and hit a fully redeemed state. Our redeem path uses a DB row lock + increment; that should be atomic but the UI list can lag if the cache TTL is long or if workers haven't invalidated it. I'll open a cache invalidation ticket for the dashboard list.

Kai (Eng): Two follow-ups: a) we should return a friendlier error to the caller, something like `voucher_max_redemptions_reached` instead of the generic expired/invalid; b) add an eventual consistency note in the dashboard tooltip. I'll file a small runtime change for (a) — low risk.

Jess — Support: For the customer resolution I gave manual steps: 1) apologize and explain race condition, 2) offer a one-time manual credit of equivalent value (I asked billing to apply a credit), 3) suggested trying a different code if they have one.

Ada · Billing: I applied a one-time credit of $25 to acct+anna@example.com and left a private note on the invoice. Transaction id: cr_20260315_8272_manual.

Jess — Support: Sent customer message: "Sorry about that — the voucher actually hit its max redemptions a few seconds before your request. I added a $25 goodwill credit to your account. If you'd like we can also investigate issuing a replacement code." :white_check_mark:

Kai (Eng): For repro steps and a test to avoid regressions: create a voucher with max_redemptions=3, then fire 5 near-simultaneous parallel POSTs and assert 3 return 200 and the rest return 410 with `voucher_max_redemptions_reached`. I'll add a small unit/integration test and a note in the Serve runtime tickets.

coupon-bot: [action] opened ticket #BILL-4322 dashboard cache invalidation on voucher list

Jess — Support: Closing here after credit applied and customer confirmed by email. Keeping thread open for Kai/Ada to follow through on the two engineering changes. Thanks all. :pray:
